progress.label: Call of Cthulhu rules transition
progress.basis: The five auditable outcomes are rules mapping; full investigator sheets; secret CoC d100 and risk previews; physical/mental consequences; end-to-end validated CoC cases.
progress.note: 0/5 full transition outcomes accepted. COC-005 adds saved age 15–89 custom investigator creation; COC-006 adds isolated SAN event calculations only. Live mystery SAN events and full rules integration are unimplemented.

roadmap.label: Full Black Meridian development roadmap
roadmap.scope: 7e rules engine + digital Keeper + procedurally generated scenarios/campaigns + optional HTML scene positions and ambient audio.
roadmap.note: 18% full-vision accepted. The v0.8.4 creation editor and tested SAN kernel are partial milestone evidence; no full gate is accepted without hosted gameplay and complete subsystem coverage.
